functions.name: revoke_rescuer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_rescuer(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

  if not private.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'admin role required';
  end if;

  update public.user_roles
  set
    role = 'user'::public.app_role,
    assigned_at = now(),
    assigned_by = (select auth.uid())
  where user_id = p_user_id
    and role = 'rescuer'::public.app_role;

end;
$function$

functions.name: notify_new_message
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_new_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

  insert into public.notifications (
    user_id,
    type,
    title,
    body,
    reference_type,
    reference_id
  )
  select
    cm.user_id,
    'message',
    'ข้อความใหม่',
    case
      when new.type = 'text' then left(coalesce(new.content, ''), 120)
      else 'ได้รับ ' || new.type
    end,
    'message',
    new.id
  from public.conversation_members cm
  where cm.conversation_id = new.conversation_id
    and cm.user_id <> new.sender_id;

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: notify_new_sos
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_new_sos()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

  insert into public.notifications (
    user_id,
    type,
    title,
    body,
    reference_type,
    reference_id
  )
  select
    ur.user_id,
    'sos',
    'SOS ใหม่',
    coalesce(new.message, 'มีผู้ขอความช่วยเหลือ'),
    'sos',
    new.id
  from public.user_roles ur
  where ur.role in (
    'rescuer'::public.app_role,
    'admin'::public.app_role
  )
  and ur.user_id <> new.owner_id;

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: notify_sos_response
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_sos_response()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  sos_owner uuid;
begin

  if new.status not in ('responding', 'resolved') then
    return new;
  end if;

  select s.owner_id
  into sos_owner
  from public.sos_events s
  where s.id = new.sos_id;

  if sos_owner is not null
     and sos_owner <> new.responder_id then

    insert into public.notifications (
      user_id,
      type,
      title,
      body,
      reference_type,
      reference_id
    )
    values (
      sos_owner,
      'rescue',
      case
        when new.status = 'responding'
          then 'หน่วยกู้ภัยกำลังตอบรับ'
        else 'SOS ได้รับการแก้ไขแล้ว'
      end,
      new.note,
      'sos',
      new.sos_id
    );

  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_roles ur
    where ur.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and ur.role = 'admin'::public.app_role
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_access_message(target_message uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.messages m
    join public.conversation_members cm
      on cm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
    where m.id = target_message
      and cm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  );
$function$

functions.name: review_rescue_request
functions.args: p_request_id uuid, p_approve boolean, p_rejection_reason text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.review_rescue_request(p_request_id uuid, p_approve boolean, p_rejection_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  target_user uuid;
begin

  if not private.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'admin role required';
  end if;

  select r.user_id
  into target_user
  from public.rescue_verification_requests r
  where r.id = p_request_id
    and r.status = 'pending'
  for update;

  if target_user is null then
    raise exception 'pending rescue verification request not found';
  end if;

  update public.rescue_verification_requests
  set
    status = case when p_approve then 'approved' else 'rejected' end,
    reviewed_at = now(),
    reviewed_by = (select auth.uid()),
    rejection_reason = case
      when p_approve then null
      else p_rejection_reason
    end
  where id = p_request_id;

  if p_approve then
    update public.user_roles
    set
      role = case
        when role = 'admin'::public.app_role then role
        else 'rescuer'::public.app_role
      end,
      assigned_at = now(),
      assigned_by = (select auth.uid())
    where user_id = target_user;
  end if;

end;
$function$

functions.name: chat_search_users
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_search_users(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, first_name text, last_name text, photo_path text, role text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    p.id,
    p.first_name,
    p.last_name,
    p.photo_path,
    ur.role::text
  from public.profiles p
  left join public.user_roles ur on ur.user_id = p.id
  where p.id <> auth.uid()
    and (
      nullif(trim(p_query), '') is null
      or concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name) ilike '%' || trim(p_query) || '%'
    )
  order by p.first_name, p.last_name
  limit 30;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_list_conversations()
 RETURNS TABLE(conversation_id uuid, other_user_id uuid, display_name text, photo_path text, last_message text, last_message_at timestamp with time zone, unread_count bigint, peer_last_read_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    c.id as conversation_id,
    peer.user_id as other_user_id,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) as display_name,
    p.photo_path,
    c.last_message_preview as last_message,
    c.last_message_at,
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.messages m
      where m.conversation_id = c.id
        and coalesce(m.is_deleted, false) = false
        and m.sender_id <> auth.uid()
        and m.created_at > coalesce(me.last_read_at, 'epoch'::timestamptz)
    ) as unread_count,
    peer.last_read_at as peer_last_read_at,
    c.updated_at
  from public.conversation_members me
  join public.conversations c on c.id = me.conversation_id
  join public.conversation_members peer
    on peer.conversation_id = c.id
   and peer.user_id <> me.user_id
  join public.profiles p on p.id = peer.user_id
  where me.user_id = auth.uid()
    and c.kind = 'direct'
    and me.archived_at is null
  order by coalesce(c.last_message_at, c.updated_at) desc;
$function$
